episodes.synopsis: The Onigami sisters find a strange creature in their home and decide to keep it. But then more of them show up.
episodes.title: A Hellish Beginning / The Envoy From Hell

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Hell receives a phone call that lights a fire under his lazy butt, but he’s too distracted by his burning love of food to buckle down!
episodes.title: Operation: Turn the Human Realm Into Hell / When You Wanna Work, But It's Hell

episodes.synopsis: A looming deadline lights a fire under Mr. Hell’s butt, but where’s a human despicable enough to toss into a hell-pit when you need one? His new roommates may have a lead!
episodes.title: The Pits of Hell / A Hellish Gift Murder Mystery

episodes.synopsis: The Chimimo make a friend they can’t live without, but is there room for a new recruit in the ranks? Later, Hazuki thinks of an industrious new use for the Chimimo.

episodes.title: Creating Hell! And Then Into the Hellfire... / A Hellish Ending
